suggestion.new: Still unverified — add a concrete scenario or a counter-example.
suggestion.check: Find a real case to test it, or write it up in 200 words.

ai.waiting: Sending this to the DeepSeek page.
ai.noneRelated: There are no other notes to compare.
ai.taskEmpty: Could not read a task title from the reply.

prompts.markdown: You must answer in Markdown, not plain text. Use headings, lists, and bold.
prompts.outline: Write an actionable outline for the note below in 3 to 6 points. Do not invent facts that are not in the note.
prompts.relate: The current note comes first, then other notes (each line: id | summary). Pick at most 3 that are actually related. Reply with a Markdown list, one exact id per item. If none match, write only NONE.
prompts.task:
Turn the note below into one todo. Reply in Markdown with exactly these two lines and nothing else:
**标题：**
**说明：**
Keep the title under 40 characters. Do not invent facts that are not in the note.

prompts.report: Using the local records below, write a short daily report. Cover what was done, what is still open, and three things to do next. Do not invent facts that are not in the records.
prompts.insight: Using the local records below, point out where effort may be going to repeated work, and suggest one change to make now. Do not invent facts that are not in the records.
prompts.plan: Using the local records below, suggest the three most worthwhile next actions and their order. Do not invent facts that are not in the records.
